title: From Spreadsheet
text: Read data from spreadsheet, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {File name} sets Full path and file name; {Sheet name} sets the name of sheet, {Range} sets the cell range entire range of used cells, {Output data type}, {Treat first column as} sets the time or data, {Sample time} sets the sampling period and offset, {Data extrapolation before first data point} sets the extrapolation method for simulation times before initial time stamp in spreadsheet Linear, {Data interpolation within time range} sets the interpolation method for simulation times that fall between two time stamps in spreadsheet Linear, {Data extrapolation after last data point} sets the extrapolation method for simulation times after last time stamp in spreadsheet Linear, {Output after last data point} sets the action after last data point Repeating, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the option to enable zero-crossing detection, {Mode} sets the category of data, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Binary, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data and {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data from spreadsheet scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: File name
params.values: Full path and file name untitled.xlsx (default) | full path | relative path

params.name: Sheet name
params.values: Name of sheet in spreadsheet Sheet1 (default) | sheet name

params.name: Range
params.values: Cell range entire range of used cells in sheet (default) | comma-separated list of column: row

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | Enum: |

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sampling period and offset 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Data extrapolation before first data point
params.values: Extrapolation method for simulation times before initial time stamp in spreadsheet Linear extrapolation (default) | Hold first value | Ground value

params.name: Data interpolation within time range
params.values: Interpolation method for simulation times that fall between two time stamps in spreadsheet Linear interpolation (default) | Zero order hold

params.name: Data extrapolation after last data point
params.values: Extrapolation method for simulation times after last time stamp in spreadsheet Linear extrapolation (default) | Hold last value | Ground value

params.name: Output after last data point
params.values: Action after last data point Repeating sequence (default) | Hold final value | Ground value

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: Option to enable zero-crossing detection off (default) | on

params.name: Mode
params.values: Category of data to specify Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Enumerated | Expression

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Specify signed or unsigned Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Binary point (default) | Best precision | Slope and bias

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Specify fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Slope
params.values: Specify slope for the fixed-point data type 2^0 (default) | positive, real-valued scalar

params.name: Bias
params.values: Specify bias for the fixed-point data type 0 (default) | real-valued scalar
